Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with a severe headache for the past three days.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I have this like really crazy headache that's been going on for a few days... Eh, around three days ago, maybe.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The headache is generalized but felt mainly around the right eye.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it kind of feels all over my head, but like mainly, um, around my right eye.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The pain is constant but fluctuates in intensity, with a severity of 8/10.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I mean it is there all the time, but like sometimes it's stronger... Ohh it's probably a eight.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The headache is described as a dull pain that can become sharp, with a gradual onset and has been progressively worsening.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's dull but sometimes it gets a bit sharper... it developed gradually... you think the headache is getting worse over the last three days? Yeah.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient experienced a visual aura ('shooting lights') when the headache started and now has photophobia (pain with bright lights).
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: when it started, I I got this like weird shooting lights. And like now like light is quite annoying, my eyes... does it hurt to look, uh, look at bright lights? Yeah, yeah. It hurts.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels sick (nauseous) with the headache but has not vomited.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I I'm sick with the headache. But I, no vomiting.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies neck pain/stiffness, speech difficulties, weakness in limbs, recent head injury, fever, or rashes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Any neck pain or neck stiffness? No... Any difficulty with speaking or, um, speech? No... Any difficulty , with weakness in your arms and legs? No.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The headache has made it difficult to focus, requiring the patient to take a couple of days off work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's hard to focus though. So, I I had to take a couple of days off work, actually.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has tried taking Ibuprofen (three a day) with no relief, although it has helped for past headaches.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I tried uh Ibuprofen... But it doesn't really help, no.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has no significant past medical history and denies a personal history of migraines.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: do you have any other medical history? Yeah, I think so. It's just the headache... Any history of migraines at all? Not myself, I've never had a migraine.

Medications.source_text: do you take any regular medication? Uh, no no.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: Do you have any allergies to any medications? Mm not that I know of.

Family_History.content: Mother and sister both have a history of migraines.
Family_History.source_text: my sister and my mom have them quite frequently.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient is 26 years old, lives with three housemates, and works in IT.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I'm twenty six year old... I live with housemates. So, three of them... I work in IT.
Do you wear glasses? Yes, I do.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient smokes and drinks alcohol socially.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I socially smoke. And I drink only socially.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient is concerned the headache could be a migraine due to family history.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I don't want it to be a migraine. Because I know what it's like, from my mom and my sister... And I know it's genetic.

Assessment.content: The impression is a migraine headache.
Assessment.source_text: unfortunately I do think this could be, a headache very similar to a migraine.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised on stronger analgesia options, including increasing Ibuprofen dose, a prescription for Naproxen, and adding Paracetamol or Codeine.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: you can take up to two tablets, three times a day... Or, I can prescribe you something stronger, like Naproxen... we can also add in other, painkillers like, Paracetamol, or Codeine.

Plan_of_Care.content: Recommended keeping a headache diary to identify potential triggers.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: It may be worth keeping a headache diary so we can try and work out what's, you know, if there's any triggers

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to consider a repeat eye test if eye strain is a concern.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I would always recommend having a repeat eye test done.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to return for review in 1-2 weeks to discuss prophylactic treatment if headaches become more frequent.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: I'd like you to come back and see me, in about uh, a week's time, week to two weeks' time... We can think about giving you medications as, prophylactic.

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised on red flag symptoms for urgent review: worsening headache, vision problems, or weakness in arms/legs.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if your headaches aren't getting any better, or they're getting worse... if you're having any problems with your vision, or weakness in your arms and legs... come back and see me sooner.
